answer: Like a mycelium web anchoring the forest floor, decentralized consensus forms a living haven where trust must slowly germinate. A solitary node is merely a fragile walnut shell, but authentic peer validation binds it into an interwoven matrix. Malicious entities seeking to harbor counterfeit personas face quadratic staking and superlinear proof-of-interaction costs that compound exponentially, starving artificial swarms before they breach the core.
